widget.description: Community iOS rebuild of the Sony FES Closet companion app.
widget.author: FES Closet Community

edit-config.string: FES Closet imports photos to use as backgrounds for your custom watchfaces.
FES Closet saves generated and shared watchface designs to your photo library.
FES Closet uses the camera so you can capture a photo and turn it into a watchface design.
FES Closet uses Bluetooth to connect to your FES U Watch and install watchfaces.
